change: Gemini answer parsing now compares normalized digit tokens in the answer against only the cited hit text/title/locator/attribution/licence and rejects values absent from those cited hits.
cases: Supports comma-grouped and Thai-digit representation of a cited 1000 value.
Rejects 2024 when absent from the cited hit.
limitations: This is lexical token matching, not entailment validation.
Matching a number does not prove that its metric, unit, period, basis, scope, or relationship is correct.
Numbers written as words are not checked.
No live Gemini request or deployment occurred.
